brands.name: Route One Surfboards
brands.short_description: Custom surfboards by Malachi Boyce in Monterey, California — performance shortboards, grovelers, and step-ups shaped for everyday California surf.

models.name: The Dirty Harry
models.description: The Dirty Harry Original The Original Dirty Harry shortboard. This board was our first go at making a CT quality board for the every condition with Jonny Craft. Wide point a little forward, but keeping the foam between your feet, the goal of this board was high performance surfing for the every day conditions. This board has a lot of curve especially through the tail for that extra release off the top, with a deep single all the way through to lock the tail down and maintain drive and speed through multiple turns. From points, to barreling beach breaks this board is an all around high performance board. With a medium nose rocker, exaggerated tail rocker and enough width to keep you stoked on average wave days, I think you will find this board fits the occasion from daily ripping around to when it’s really on. Available in squash tail, round tail, or swallow. Average Dims: 5-10 x 18 1/2 x 2 1/4 at 25.7 liters Starting at $725

models.name: The Dirty Harry X
models.description: The Dirty Harry X (DHX) This board came about over a period of about 5 years of testing in every condition with Jonny Craft. The goal was to make a performance board that could line up anything a CT quality surfer could ever need. Using the template for the Original Dirty Harry we pulled in the nose and tail just a bit to add a bit more curve. We also changed the rocker to allow the natural curves of the board to run free with a more continuous curve by increasing the nose rocker and taking out some of the curve through the tail. We kept the deep single all the way through to keep the board to keep it sensitive, but with the combo of the deep single, narrower tail and decreased tail curve expect this board to have a little more projection and drive than the loser OG Dirty Harry. I think you will find this board fits the occasion when the waves are good and you really want to stay on rail with control and drive. Available in squash tail, round tail or swallow. Average Dims: 5-10 x 18 1/2 x 2 1/4 at 25.7 liters Starting at $725

models.name: The Dirty Harry Short
models.description: The Dirty Harry Short This is a shorter, wider, thicker version of the OG Dirty Harry model. A wide point forward, full thickness performance board meant to be ridden 2” shorter and a 1/4” wider than the original. This board was one of our first spring time favorites. Deep single all the way through with a lot of tail flip, combined with a low nose rocker makes this board flashy and fun, with a lot of the same performance features you would expect from the DH line. Available in squash and swallow. Average dimensions 5-8 x 18 3/4 x 2 1/4 at 26 liters. Starting at $725

models.name: The Throwback
models.description: The Throwback The Throwback is a board we’ve been making off and on privately for a few years that just recently took shape into something really special. This is a board born in the early 2000s with a modern twist to bring it back to life. Think Campaign 1 days of 6-1 and 6-2 swords. We decided if we were going to go retro, we wanted to connect with the days of being 12 years old watching those punk movies of thrash and bash surfing. So we took the Dirty Harry OG model, went narrower thinner and longer then we bent it in half. The focus of this board was projection of the bottom and out of turns to keep it moving. Its not the most amount of rocker we’ve ever done…. BUT ITS A LOT. AND ITS A LOT OF FUN. It does have a modern fuller plan shape and more foam under the chest then those old boards and that’s the 2020 influence you will feel that allows the board to paddle really well and maintain speed. This is a board for pro level rail and barrel thrashing, or someone who just wants to experiment with their surfing and try something new. We have actually had a lot of success with this board in the average surfer range. Either way let the nostalgia take the lead, throw on some old surf flicks, and let it rip with this board. Its a lot fo fun and I had maybe the most amount of fun i’ve ever had shaping them. Available currently as a squash but I could be convinced otherwise. Average dims 5-10 x 18 1/4 x 2 1/8 at 23.5 liters. And 5-10 x 18 1/2 x 2 1/4 at 25.5 liters. Starting at $725

models.name: X3
models.description: The X3 The X3 is the 3rd iteration of our performance groveler. We took the classic outline of the original X-Model and combined that with foil and concaves of our TunaBunny model to make something really special. A board that paddles great, is fast and loose in the pocket, and can be ridden in anything 1-4 foot, and even pretty solid waves. Expect a lot of driver and hold from this board with a controlled release when necessary. The team has been having a lot of fun on this board saying it has the paddle power and down the line speed of the TunaBunny, with that added performance of a shortboard. And this thing holds. The air guys love it too. On the other side this board also works really well for those transitioning to their first ever shortboard. You get that extra volume in a short package that performs well in more critical surf. But also the added stability of a wider plan shape. Rolled vee in the nose also helps slip into waves on those steeper drops giving you little extra freedom push it a bit. This board is a great daily driver, great average to weak waves board, great for intermediate/beginners who want the shorter board under their feet. Average dimensions: 5-5 x 19 x 2 1/4 @ 26 liters and 6-0 x 20 x 2 5/8 @ 35 liters '-Malachi Starting at $725

models.name: The Ham 2.0
models.description: The Ham 2.0 This model is an updated re-write of our original Ham and Cheese shortboard. Your average lunchbox shortboard. Following the design intent, plan shape and rocker of the original, this board is intended to be your daily driver of choice for a shortboard that can handle a wide variety of conditions. This board has a wide speed box in the outline running through the middle third of the board with a wider nose and tail, marrying up to a flat spot through the middle third of the rocker. This allows the board to maintain speed through flat sections and create a really user friendly platform for the average surfer and or average wave condition. Through the tail and nose of the board we have a little bit of flip creating a little more rocker and release for easy turning and adjustments in more critical sections of a wave. The updated foil on this board spreads foam generously throughout the board from nose to tail for an easy to paddle shortboard that again maintains speed. From beginner to advanced you will find this board to fill the vast majority of your surfing requirements on a performance level and makes a great travel companion. Average Dims: 5-10 x 18 3/4 x 2 1/4 at 26 liters. -Malachi Starting at $725

models.name: The Explorer
models.description: The Explorer The Explorer is an all around performance board engineered to fit a wide variety of conditions. Full plan shape down to a pulled in pintail. Low rocker with a little bit of tail flip. Relatively flat overall. This board paddles like a dream. However, this board can still fit any curve and any wave face from small mushy waves, to 6 foot barrels. Meant to be ridden as a shorter relaxed performance drivers, or even as long as your height for a very user friendly platform to get to know surfing. Progressive surfers should ride this board 6 inches shorter than their height, and 1 liter more volume than a normal shortboard. Beginners shoot for a few inches shorter than your height. Or a little more spark and little more creativity, order as a 4 channel bottom. -Malachi Starting at $725

models.name: The Super Tramp
models.description: The Super Tramp The Super Tramp is a really high performance approach to a retro plan shape. This board has a good amount of rocker, thin rails and a medium amount of foam spread evenly throughout the board. A little bit of tail flip and really deep single to double concave throughout as well. The goal was to create a fishy board, to feed that need for more foam and speed, but still have the board feel as homey and predictable as a lose performance thruster. Less twin fin. More thruster. I think you will find this board holds a rail just like a shorty, and paddles and skates just like a fish. Ride this board as short as 6 inches less than your height, and 3 liters more volume than your performance board. Average Dims: 5-5 x 19 3/4 x 2 3/8 with K2 Keels from futures. -Malachi Starting at $725

models.name: The Bobby Ricky
models.description: The Bobby Ricky For when you just wanna go FAST. This board s all about speed, flow and agility in a short package. It carries width throughout, broken up by the flyer swallow in the tail. The narrows tail adds bite and grab, while the deck channels create hold. The rocker is flat, but curvy through the nose and tail creating a speed box effect under the front foot and release off the tail. The single double to vee throughout gives the board a little more accented curve on the rail line, to make the low rocker more playful and fluid. Ride this board about 5 inches shorter than your height for intermediate surfers, and about 2 inches shorted for more foam without sacrificing performance. -Malachi Starting at $725

models.name: The Ham and Cheese
models.description: The Ham and Cheese Our original daily driver shortboard. A daily standard shortboard for performance surfer. The shortboard that kicked it all off for us. This shortboard is a blend of high performance and stability to create an all in one daily driver. Thinner and less foam than the Ham2.0 this board is fast and agile. It was received through a kind of cult following at the beginning of route one where high performance surfers could use this board just about anywhere, any time. Lots of nose and tail flip on this board makes it spicy. And the flat section under the front foot makes it fast. The loose feeling in the tail is predictable, the paddle is good, and it has a knifey rail for critical sections. However, it has less drive than the updated version the Ham2.0 and less paddle power. A great board with a little more performance under the foot of a better surfer than the Ham2.0. Custom orders only. If you remember it, and you loved it, we still make it. But we kinda sold you out for a more user friendly platform in the Ham2.0 which can be an option to go shorter. But again, we will still make on for you all day long. : ) Standard dimensions: 5-10 x 18 1/2 x 2 1/4 at 25.5 liters. -Malachi Starting at $725

models.name: The Stranger Danger
models.description: The Stranger Danger The Stranger Danger is a shortboard we built with team rider Dane Anderson. With this board we wanted something with a lot of rocker for hard on rail performance, with a wider plan shape and more foam for more functionality as a daily driver in a wide variety of conditions. A travel savvy board, that can contest. Using the Ham as our template, we made this board with a more continuous rocker, and left the deep double to vee in the concaves to bring back the flip in the rail, and eliminated the hip. This gave us a lot of drive and hold on rail, but still allowed the extra width to lay over on rail easily as well. And the result was a board the NSSA kids and traveling surfers picked up on right away. Average Dims: 5-11 x 19 x 2 7/16 at 28.5 liters. -Malachi Starting at $725

models.name: The John Doe
models.description: The John Doe The John Doe is a performance board we built with Josh Mulcoy for hard drawn out on rail lines and barrels in good waves. If big carves are your game this board is for you. Medium continuous rocker throughout. With a deep single all the way through the John Doe is sensitive but holds a rail for a long time. This board drives hard, and keeps speed throughout turns without slowing down. And the forward outline makes it a very good barrel board as well. Most commonly ridden as a swallowtail to increase accuracy and strike percentages in the lip, ride this board about a 1/2 inch to whole inch shorter than your average board. More commonly 2” shorter than you are tall. Josh Mulcoys Dims: 5-9 1/2 x 18 3/4 x 2 1/4 @ 25.7 liters. -Malachi Starting at $725

models.name: The Ham Air
models.description: The Ham Air The general focus for this board was one reason. A performance shorty that holds on rail, but creates the perfect platform for big airs. Based on our standard shortboard the Ham 2.0. We lowered the entry rocker just a touch, widened the nose quite a bit the liven up the speed box under your front foot, and added a little tail kick to get that “Click” off the tail right before you hit the lip. This is a shortboard for ramps. Again the goal was get in early, get there fast and send it. With enough of a crash pad up front to stomp some. After it was all sent and done one thing we also really love about this board is it makes a really great average waves board as well for those looking for a little more foam under the chest. This board has a lot more foam up front with a wider plan shape. Those elements go hand in hand with big controlled airs, and paddle speed with ease of use. So don’t think because your not an air guy this board isnt for you, we actually build most of these boards for people looking to go shorter wider thicker than their traditional Ham 2.0. So if your looking for more volume and not quite up for a total pig, or really just want to work on punts, this board is great. Stock average dimension 5-7 x 19 x 2 1/4 @ 26liters. -Malachi Starting at $725

models.name: The Tuna Bunny
models.description: The Tuna Bunny The Tuna Bunny is a sparky little board with a lot of performance in a groveler package. Designed as a low rocker Twin fin WITH a trailer, expect a lot of drive and speed out of this little rocket. The plan shape is full from tip to tail, a full foil with a little bit of hidden foam in the rear of the board. This give the board a lot of speed between the feet helping that 2+1 feel like a SuperCharged Trifin with hold. Low rocker helps paddle power and speed in a short package. a lot of surface area to keep it up to plane. Also available in a TriFin package with a chopped swallow tail. This board is just fun fun fun and one of our number one sellers for beginners and advanced surfers alike. -Malachi Starting at $725

models.name: The Promnight
models.description: The Promnight For when its time to step it up, and try to score. This board has a lot of rocker and a lot of performance. But don’t let that fool you it still paddles. The intent of this board is to shorten up the radius and make a 6-8 feel like a 6-3 when the wall accommodates, but still lock in the barrel with a more forward stance as well. More foam in the rear of this board helps the wave pick you up from deep, but it also allows the board to project and drive like a shortboard. This board is a spicy and thin performance board for those days when its really hollow, or big lined up walls. Foam throughout and a little bit of vee under the nose help this board paddle and roll right in. This board has been ridden everywhere from Sunset to Pascuales and everywhere in between. If consistency and performance is the ask, its the answer. Ride this board 8” taller than you are, 1/8 thicker than your shortboard at the same width. Average Dims: 6-8 x 18 3/4 x 2 1/2. Comes standard in StepUp Glass Job (6oz bottom, and a 4oz plus 4s deck) and 7mm Appelcore Stringer with a heavier foam weight. Recommended in Epoxy. -Malachi Starting at $825
